tables.name: metadata_sources
tables.description: The metadata source releases in the store; `pinned` marks the one the metadata tables read.

tables.name: sample_metadata_cmd
tables.description: Sample metadata curated by curatedMetagenomicData (curation repo, pinned commit), one row per field. `field`/`value` are harmonized where the field map covers the field.
tables.grain: one row per sample, field and cMD sample record

tables.name: sample_metadata_harmonized
tables.description: One value per sample and harmonized field, with the source and source release it came from (precedence: cMD curation, then Olm R1/R2 not imported from cMD, then Olm R3/R4 with confidence >= 0.5). Mixes Olm-derived values; attribution required: Microbiome Repo, OlmLab, release R2026.25 (data package 1.20.0), doi:10.5281/zenodo.23087712; values derived. Required attribution for the CC-BY-4.0 tables.
tables.grain: one row per sample and field

tables.name: sample_metadata_olm
tables.description: Sample metadata from the Olm lab Microbiome Repo (pinned release), one row per field, with Olm's route and confidence; no evidence quotes. Attribution required: Microbiome Repo, OlmLab, release R2026.25 (data package 1.20.0), doi:10.5281/zenodo.23087712; values derived. Required attribution for the CC-BY-4.0 tables.
tables.grain: one row per sample, field and Olm sample

tables.name: samples
tables.description: One row per sample in the release: the join hub from readset id to run accessions, BioSample and BioProject, with the pipeline version that produced it.
